purpose: Locate every Form 4 that reports an open-market purchase (transaction code P) for the ten tracked issuers, using the SEC's own EDGAR full-text search instead of walking every filing. The rendered-view lane then captures each located filing verbatim (raw/form, raw/index) and scripts/stage_sec_rendered.py parses it fail-closed.

method.phrase_logic: A Form 4 XML transactionCoding block tokenises as '<formType> <transactionCode> <equitySwapInvolved>'. The phrase "4 P false" (or "4 P 0" for filers that write the boolean as 0) therefore matches exactly the filings that carry a code-P non-derivative transaction. Validated on MU August 2026 sales: the phrase "4 S false" returned exactly the three MU Form 4s that report code-S sales (0001242654-26-000015, 0001798757-26-000007, 0001311079-26-000003) and nothing else.
caveats: The ciks= filter matches any CIK on the filing, including filings where a tracked issuer is the *reporting owner* of another company (JPM as owner of Ribbon Communications, NVIDIA as owner of Serve Robotics). Those hits are recorded below as NOT-ISSUER and were not captured; the parser would also reject them on the issuer ticker check.
forms=4 excludes amendments; the 4/A query below was run separately and returned nothing.
Purchases that a filer reports only in Table II (derivative) or with a non-standard boolean spelling would not match; phrases "4 P true" and "4 P 1" were also run and returned nothing.

www.sec.gov answered several index-page requests with its 'File Unavailable' apology page during this pass; for those filings the SGML header page (<accession>-index-headers.html) was captured instead, which carries the same filing/acceptance/period dates.

queries.note: amendments (4/A) reporting a code-P purchase: none

0000019617-25-000335 (JPMorgan as reporting owner of Ribbon Communications) and 0001045810-24-000232 (NVIDIA as reporting owner of Serve Robotics) are NOT-ISSUER hits and were not captured. enddt=2025-05-31 answered 'Internal server error'; 2025-05-30 was used, so 2025-05-31 (a Saturday, no filings) is the only day not covered by either window.
